name: io.github.iowarp/adios-mcp
title: CLIO Adios
description: Fetch and analyze BP5 data files using ADIOS2. Access scientific data, metadata, and attributes...

tools.name: list_bp5
tools.description: Lists the BP4/BP5 files (.bp, .bp5) in a directory, by default the server's working directory.

tools.name: inspect_variables
tools.description: Inspects variables in a BP5 file, returning type, shape, and steps. Optionally filters by variable name.

tools.name: inspect_variables_at_step
tools.description: Inspects a specific variable at a given step in a BP5 file. All parameters are required.

tools.name: inspect_attributes
tools.description: Reads global or variable-specific attributes from a BP5 file. The 'variable_name' is optional.

tools.name: read_variable_at_step
tools.description: Reads a variable at one step as a flattened row-major list with its shape. Pass start/count (one value per dimension) to read a slice; reads above max_elements (default 10000) are refused, so use variable_stats for summaries.

tools.name: variable_stats
tools.description: Per-step min, max, mean and std of a variable over a step range, with the (i, j, k, ...) index of each step's min and max and the overall extremes. Optionally restricted to a start/count slice.

resources.name: adios_capabilities
resources.description: ADIOS2 file format capabilities and supported engines.

prompts.name: explore_bp_file
prompts.description: Guided workflow for exploring an ADIOS2 BP file.
